description: This file defines an interface for a client addressable test grain in an Orleans project, including methods for setting a target, messaging, and stress tests.

classes.name: IClientAddressableTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a client addressable test grain with various messaging and stress test methods.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target client object for this grain.

methods.name: HappyPath
methods.description: Sends a message and expects a string response, representing a successful or 'happy' path.

methods.name: SadPath
methods.description: Sends a message and handles a failure or 'sad' path scenario.

methods.name: MicroSerialStressTest
methods.description: Performs a serial stress test with the specified iteration count.

methods.name: MicroParallelStressTest
methods.description: Performs a parallel stress test with the specified iteration count.
